description: The chart represents the distribution of various categories within the Darija Open Dataset, Version 2. The donut chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories and their corresponding colors are: Moroccan Names (brown), Semantic Categories (purple), Syntactic Roles (dark brown), Translated Sentences (olive green), Extra + Augmented Data (blue), and Pending Translations (green). The proportions of these categories are approximately: Moroccan Names (less than 1%), Semantic Categories (less than 1%), Syntactic Roles (16%), Translated Sentences (32%), Extra + Augmented Data (21%), and Pending Translations (30%). The chart includes a legend that maps the colors to their respective categories, and some slices have numerical labels indicating their quantities. The slices are arranged in no particular order, and none are visually emphasized.
